Refund & Cancellation Policy

Last updated: 26 September 2026

CAtool and TallyDrop — currently free

The CAtool hub (and its tools) and TallyDrop are offered free of charge during early access. No payment, card, or subscription is taken to install or use them — so there is nothing to refund today.

Docward Pro — 7-day refund

Docward Pro is a one-time purchase (not a subscription), paid through Razorpay. If it isn't right for you, ask for a refund within 7 days of purchase — no questions asked.

  • Email akshaybkn@gmail.com with your Razorpay Payment ID (it starts with pay_ and is on your receipt).
  • We refund the full amount to your original payment method through Razorpay. Razorpay usually takes 5–7 working days to credit it.
  • After a refund, please stop using the Pro licence; the free version of Docward keeps working.
  • After 7 days we still refund genuine billing errors, such as a double charge.

If paid plans are introduced for CAtool or TallyDrop

We may add paid plans in the future. If and when we do, this policy will be updated with the applicable cancellation and refund terms before any charge is taken. Our intent is to keep them fair and simple:

  • A free period to test fit against your real client list before any payment.
  • Cancel any time, with no charge after cancellation.
  • Prompt refunds for genuine billing errors (double-charges, charges after cancellation) and for extended service outages caused by us.
